name: sent
description: Send and manage SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS messages with Sent. Register US A2P 10DLC brands and campaigns, author WhatsApp templates, launch RCS agents, build webhooks, analyze deliverability, and migrate from other messaging providers.

interface.longDescription: Send SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS messages and manage contacts, templates, Sender Profiles, and analytics through the Sent MCP server. Specialist skills cover US A2P 10DLC registration, WhatsApp Business (WABA) templates and embedded signup, RCS agent launch, webhook receivers with signature verification, channel routing, two-way messaging, delivery diagnosis, SDK integration, and staged migration from another CPaaS provider.
defaultPrompt: Use $sent-integration-starter to review how this application should integrate Sent safely.
Use $sent-routing-strategist to explain the safest channel and reroute policy for this workflow.
Use $migrate-to-sent to plan a staged migration from our current messaging provider.
